{{Top|leg}}
The '''Mon Calamari Communications Control''' was the primary communications center established by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] on [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. After the fall of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Mon Calamari became the temporary [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and the majority of the government's operations were relocated to the communications center.
